description: Complete planetary dignities database for Vedic astrology (Jyotish). Single source of truth for dignity calculations.

sun.name: Sun
sun.notes: Sun cannot be combusted (it is the source of combustion). Natural significator of soul, vitality, authority.

moon.name: Moon
moon.notes: Fastest moving planet. Natural significator of mind, emotions, motherhood. Combustion affects emotional clarity.

mars.name: Mars
mars.notes: Significator of courage, action, conflict, passion. Combustion reduces assertiveness and courage.

mercury.name: Mercury
mercury.notes: Significator of intellect, communication, commerce. Combustion affects clarity of thought and expression. Different orb when retrograde.

jupiter.name: Jupiter
jupiter.notes: Significator of wisdom, prosperity, fortune, spirituality. Combustion diminishes benefic influence and luck.

venus.name: Venus
venus.notes: Significator of love, beauty, luxury, relationships. Combustion affects relationships and aesthetic sensibilities. Different orb when retrograde.

saturn.name: Saturn
saturn.notes: Significator of discipline, karma, limitation, age. Combustion weakens Saturn's stabilizing and learning influences.

rahu.name: Rahu
rahu.notes: Shadow planet (lunar node). No traditional own signs. Exalted in Taurus or Gemini depending on tradition. Debilitated in Scorpio or Sagittarius. No combustion as shadow body.

ketu.name: Ketu
ketu.notes: Shadow planet (lunar node, opposite Rahu). No traditional own signs. Exalted in Scorpio, debilitated in Taurus. No combustion as shadow body. Represents dissipation, spirituality, past-life karma.

sources.primary: Brihat Parashara Hora Shastra (BPHS) - Classical Jyotish text
sources.combustion: Based on heliacal rising/setting cycles and Sun's angular distance

dignity_ranks.1_exalted: Planet in exaltation sign at or near exact degree
dignity_ranks.3_moolatrikona: Planet in moolatrikona region (special portion of own sign)
dignity_ranks.4_friendly_sign: Planet in sign of friendly planet
dignity_ranks.5_neutral_sign: Planet in sign of neutral planet
dignity_ranks.6_enemy_sign: Planet in sign of enemy planet
dignity_ranks.7_debilitated: Planet in debilitation sign at or near exact degree
dignity_ranks.8_combusted: Planet too close to Sun (specific distance threshold)

computation_notes.exaltation_orb: Typically 5 degrees from exact degree, though some use 3-8 degrees depending on tradition
computation_notes.debilitation: Works inversely to exaltation - planet is weak in these conditions
computation_notes.moolatrikona: Considered intermediate dignity - stronger than friendly/neutral but weaker than exaltation
computation_notes.combustion: Occurs when planet is within combustion distance of Sun. Effect varies by planet.
computation_notes.retrograde_combustion: Mercury and Venus have different combustion orbs when retrograde
computation_notes.shadow_planets: Rahu and Ketu have no combustion and their dignity calculation is less precise than classical planets
